title: Non-destructive testing of mechanical components achieved by hybrid copper–iodide cluster
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,11639-11644
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00959F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rui-jia Dong, Ze-qi Wu
A Cu4I4(3-pic)4 scintillator with high X-ray attenuation and PLQY was synthesized. The in situ fabricated screen achieved high light yield, low detection limit, and high spatial resolution, enabling efficient non-destructive testing.
